name: Edelény (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Edelény (a green and red shield with a yellow cross, a bunch of grapes, an eagle and crossed hammers, within a green wreath) below the name EDELÉNY in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
